description: Known answers of the Pi controller's ATAK / Cursor on Target emitter (controller/atalaia_controller/atak.py), for its port to the Android field controller (app/lib/controller/controller_atak.dart, PE24 slice S7), which must give the same text byte for byte (app/test/controller/controller_atak_test.dart). xml_text: value, limit, max_bytes -> out. numbers: cot_time (seconds -> text), deg (_deg), metres (_metres; null is unknown), fixed0 (the remarks' '{:.0f}'). colours: team_colour and atak_team per name with the game's teams, argb_of (rgb, alpha), kml_colour, feature_colour. extraction: VIP / Payload's parameter -> [lat, lon] or null. endpoints: parse_endpoint (host, port or error). config: check_config's verdict. events: event_xml with marker_detail (marker) or a player's details as AtakEmitter._players builds them (player), or none; refused_points: [lat, lon] event_xml refuses. features: feature_xml (xml, type, lat, lon) for a feature on a map position (georef: its control points). drops: drop_xml. Every xml is the XML declaration, a newline and the event as xml.etree.ElementTree serialises it. Generated by tools/atak_xml_vectors.py from atak.py itself (run it again after changing atak.py; --check fails when this file is stale).
